exposure: Infants without improved length during NICU stay
Infants with improved length during NICU stay
finding: Birth weight was significantly correlated with increased rate of weight gain in the first 6 weeks of life, while microbial diversity increased with age and was significantly correlated with weight gain and percentage of mother's own milk.
mod_finding: Infants who showed improved length during their NICU stay, all of whom were delivered by Caesarean section, had significantly more volatile microbial beta diversity results than and a significantly decreased microbial maturity index compared with infants who did not.
